decisions.decision: Keep proven W128D20 and W256D16 capacity; replace old unstarted M/L/XL candidates with exactly four named runs. No MPI baseline, no extra third size.
decisions.evidence: W128 partial best37.659301 at45/65,6.836M params; R3 partial best37.430162 at32/54,20.192M; late train/test divergence.

decisions.decision: Move all different-seed repeats after the four final models. Train detector models fresh, then fine-tune each GT2D model from its own same-width best EMA for30 epochs. No128-to256 partial weight mapping.
decisions.evidence: User asks whether to fine-tune GT2D and explicitly prioritizes seed repeats last; strict checkpoint loading requires matching widths.

decisions.decision: User requests immediate parallel downstream work because MPI alone underutilizes the GPU. Launch only FINAL-W128-DET2D-S0 alongside MPI after concurrent B1/B2/B4 PASS; do not add W256 as a third job.
